description: Built 7 April 1976; delivered 9 April 1976; registered 26 April 1976 as CCCP-88167 to the Armenian Civil Aviation Directorate 2nd Yerevan detachment at Zvartnots; to Armenian Airlines and re-registered EK-88167 in 1993; stored at Zvartnots after withdrawal; later erected on the private grounds of a recreation base (a former Pioneer camp) on Lake Sevan about 4 km from Chkalovka on the Martuni road; intended for use as a children's cafe
